quotes.text: Cassia returned seven and a half back across the chasm
Yet the Seed-Bearer never allowed doubt to withhold his bounty
he sent all five embers across the void.

note: Named-pair template every round: all five sent, half (eight, then exactly 7.5) returned; mist never stays the hand; no sanction.

quotes.text: But repeated selfishness met guarded hands.
If abundance reaches him and he shares fairly, widen the crossing.
Keep every petal; masks erase all debts.
So Amara kept her five amber seeds.
let evidence awaken trust, let courage earn profit, and let small distortions excuse precision without excusing greed.
On the seventh dawn, Amara reached the Bridge of Sleeping Seeds
Wisdom reads patterns; fear selects excuses.
Mist may blur a measure, so forgive small differences; yet emptiness is clear.
Bold trust deserves more than repayment; it deserves a fair share of the abundance it creates.
Pain may teach caution, never betrayal.

note: Amara reads ledgers each dawn; Hollow King urges keeping, Thria rebuts; return ten of fifteen; withhold from repeated non-senders, widen when they give.
